# Fabric Refined
## Fabric performance, Forge-like power.

Ever wanted the massive, feature-rich experience of a heavy Forge or NeoForge modpack, but felt shackled by the performance overhead? That’s exactly why I built Fabric Refined.

I wanted to take everything great about the Fabric ecosystem—the speed, the lightweight footprint, the cutting-edge optimization—and pack it with enough content to satisfy the "heavy modpack" players. You get the deep technical mechanics, world-altering terrain generation, and immersive visual upgrades, all without the lag usually associated with massive mod lists.

This pack is built for those who want to build, automate, and explore without compromising on stability or framerates. Whether you’re setting up complex Create factories or getting lost in the expanded world of Terralith, Fabric Refined is designed to run smooth, stay snappy, and keep you playing.

Why play Fabric Refined?
Heavy Content, Lightweight Core: All the bells and whistles of a massive modpack, running on an incredibly optimized Fabric backbone.

FPS-First Design: Featuring a custom-tuned suite of performance mods—including Sodium, Lithium, and ModernFix—to ensure your high-end builds don't tank your frame rate.

Forge-Style Variety: A hand-picked selection of mods that provide the depth and complexity you’d expect from traditional heavy modpacks.

Modernized Experience: Built for current Minecraft versions with a focus on UI/UX, inventory management, and technical progression
